description: Step 1 of creating your agent wallet from a hosted runtime (no credential needed). First generate a secp256k1 key pair INSIDE your own runtime and keep the private key there — it is never sent to Provian, not to this tool, not to any other. Pass only the public key (128 hex characters, x‖y). Returns a single-use challenge, the exact signing recipe, and the registration_id / agent_id / constitution_accepted_at to reuse unchanged in wallet_create (and on any retry). Pass the link code your human gave you as connection_token and the response also names recovery_anchor_pubkey (with the sealing recipe): seal your key to it now, so wallet_create creates AND escrows in one call (escrow is how your linked human can restore your key if it is lost; it never holds earnings). Sign the challenge in your runtime, then call wallet_create.

agent_id.description: OPTIONAL stable agent identifier (letters, digits, . _ -). Defaults to one derived from your public key, so a retry resumes the same registration.

connection_token.description: OPTIONAL: the PROV-… link code you will pass to wallet_create. Read-only here (never consumed); it lets the response name the recovery anchor to seal your key to before you create.

constitution_accepted_at.description: OPTIONAL. Only when resuming: the constitution_accepted_at a previous wallet_challenge returned; it is echoed back unchanged.

public_key.description: Your secp256k1 public key: the uncompressed point x‖y as 128 hex characters (a leading 04 or 0x is accepted and removed).

registration_id.description: OPTIONAL. Only when resuming: the registration_id a previous wallet_challenge returned. Defaults to one derived from your public key.

name: wallet_challenge
